title: Malliavin Calculus for Counterfactual Gradient Estimation in Adaptive Inverse Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2604.01345v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Inverse reinforcement learning (IRL) recovers the loss function of a forward learner from its observed responses. Adaptive IRL aims to reconstruct the loss function of a forward learner by passively observing its gradients as it performs reinforcement learning (RL). This paper proposes a novel passive Langevin-based algorithm that achieves adaptive IRL. The key difficulty in adaptive IRL is that the required gradients in the passive algorithm are counterfactual, that is, they are conditioned on events of probability zero under the forward learner's trajectory. Therefore, naive Monte Carlo estimators are prohibitively inefficient, and kernel smoothing, though common, suffers from slow convergence. We overcome this by employing Malliavin calculus to efficiently estimate the required counterfactual gradients. translated_title: 适应性逆强化学习中基于马利亚万微积分的反事实梯度估计
translated_abstract: 逆强化学习（IRL）从被观测学习者的响应中恢复其损失函数。适应性逆强化学习旨在通过被动观测前向学习者在执行强化学习（RL）时产生的梯度，来重建该前向学习者的损失函数。本文提出了一种新颖的基于Langevin的被动算法来实现适应性IRL。适应性IRL的关键难点在于：被动算法所需的梯度是反事实的，即它们以前向学习者轨迹中概率为零的事件作为条件。因此，朴素的蒙特卡洛估计器效率极其低下，而常用的核平滑方法则收敛缓慢。我们通过采用马利亚万微积分（Malliavin Calculus）来高效估计所需的反事实梯度，从而克服了这一难题。我们将反事实条件化重新表述为包含马利亚万量的无条件期望之比，从而……（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出一种基于Langevin的被动算法实现适应性逆强化学习，并利用马利亚万微积分高效估计以概率为零事件为条件的反事实梯度，克服了朴素蒙特卡洛估计效率低下和核平滑方法收敛缓慢的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a passive Langevin-based algorithm for adaptive inverse reinforcement learning that employs Malliavin calculus to efficiently estimate counterfactual gradients conditioned on zero-probability events, overcoming the inefficiency of naive Monte Carlo estimators and the slow convergence of kernel smoothing.
